s1.title: Omusingi
s1.description: Okulamusa, abantu, emmere, ennamba, obudde, ebifo, awaka n’obulamu.

s2.title: Obulamu bwa buli lunaku
s2.description: Nnyonnyola ebintu, yambala, yogera ku lunaku lwo, obudde, ebisolo, emirimu, essomero n’entambula.

s3.title: Emboozi
s3.description: Gaana, buuza ebibuuzo, yogera ku byayita n’ebijja, enneewulira, eby’okwesanyusaamu, essimu n’okufumba.

s4.title: Ekitundu n’obuwangwa
s4.description: Ebika n’emiziro, obwakabaka, okulima, emikolo, ennyimba, eddiini, bizinensi n’obutonde.

s5.title: Omwogezi omukugu
s5.description: Geraageranya, teebereza, nnyumya emboozi, kozesa engero, goberera amawulire, kola ku bigwa bitalaze era olage ekitiibwa.

u1.title: Okulamusa
u1.description: Lamusa, weeyanjule era obale okutuuka ku kkumi.

u2.title: Abantu n’ebintu
u2.description: Ab’omu maka, ebintu bya buli lunaku n’ebikolwa byo ebisooka.

u3.title: Emmere n’akatale
u3.description: Manya emmere, gamba nti olumwa enjala, era ogule mu katale.

u4.title: Ennamba ne ssente
u4.description: Bala okutuuka ku nkumi era osasule mu ssiringi.

u5.title: Obudde n’ennaku
u5.description: Yogera ku leero, ennaku za wiiki n’essaawa.

u6.title: Ebifo n’amakubo
u6.description: Manya ebifo mu kibuga, gamba gy’ogenda era olage ekkubo.

u7.title: Awaka
u7.description: Ebisenge n’ebintu by’omu nnyumba, okwaniriza abagenyi n’okusaba ebintu.

u8.title: Obulamu n’omubiri
u8.description: Manya ebitundu by’omubiri, gamba ekikuluma era olabe omusawo.

u9.title: Langi n’okunnyonnyola
u9.description: Manya langi era onnyonnyole ebintu n’abantu.

u10.title: Engoye
u10.description: Manya engoye zo, yambala era ogule ekipya.

u11.title: Olunaku lwange
u11.description: Yogera ku by’okola buli lunaku okuva ku makya okutuuka ekiro.

u12.title: Obudde n’ebiseera by’omwaka
u12.description: Yogera ku njuba n’enkuba, ebiseera by’omwaka n’okuwulira ebbugumu oba empewo.

u13.title: Ebisolo
u13.description: Ebisolo by’omu ffaamu, eby’omu nsiko, eby’awaka n’engaali ya Uganda.

u14.title: Emirimu
u14.description: Gamba ky’okola, buuza ku mirimu era oyogere ku musaala.

u16.title: Entambula
u16.description: Kwata takisi oba bbaasi era otegeke olugendo mu Uganda.

u18.title: Okubuuza ebibuuzo
u18.description: Buuza ani, ki, wa, ddi ne lwaki, era obuuze ku bigambo.

u19.title: Bye nnakoze
u19.description: Gamba by’okoze leero, bye wakola jjo n’edda.

u20.title: Enteekateeka
u20.description: Yogera ku nkya, wiikendi n’ebirooto byo.

u21.title: Enneewulira
u21.description: Gamba bw’owulira era olage nti ofaayo ku balala.

u22.title: Eby’okwesanyusaamu n’emizannyo
u22.description: Yogera ku biseera eby’eddembe, omupiira, ennyimba n’emizannyo.

u23.title: Ku ssimu
u23.description: Kuba essimu, weereza obubaka era otegeke okusisinkana.

u24.title: Okufumba
u24.description: Goberera enfumba, fumba matooke mu ndagala era ogabane emmere.

u25.title: Ebika n’emiziro
u25.description: Manya ebika bya Buganda, emiziro gyabyo n’okugamba ggwe ani.

u26.title: Obwakabaka
u26.description: Kabaka, gavumenti ye n’ebifo eby’ebyafaayo bya Buganda.

u27.title: Ekyalo n’okulima
u27.description: Kola mu nnimiro, manya ebirime era okungule.

u28.title: Emikolo
u28.description: Kwanjula, embaga, amazaalibwa n’okwagaliza abantu ebirungi.

u29.title: Ennyimba n’amazina
u29.description: Engoma, ennyimba n’amazina, n’okunnyonnyola abantu okusinziira ku bye bakola.

u30.title: Eddiini n’ennaku enkulu
u30.description: Ebifo eby’okusinzizaamu, Ssekukkulu, Idd, olunaku lw’Abajulizi n’emikisa.

u31.title: Bizinensi
u31.description: Ddukanya edduuka etono, weereza bakasitoma, tereka ssente era oyigirize abalala.

u32.title: Obutonde
u32.description: Ennyanja, emigga, ebibira n’obusozi, n’okulabirira ettaka.

u33.title: Okugeraageranya
u33.description: Gamba ekisinga obunene, ekisinga obulungi, ekifaanagana oba ekyawukana.

u34.title: Bwe… ne singa…
u34.description: Yogera ku bibaawo bwe…, ebyandibaddewo singa…, ne by’oyagala.

u35.title: Okunyumya emboozi
u35.description: Tandika emboozi, gyeyongereyo ne “awo” era ogimalirize.

u36.title: Engero
u36.description: Yiga engero za Baganda ezimanyiddwa, amakulu gaazo ne ddi lw’oziyogera.

u37.title: Amawulire n’ekitundu
u37.description: Goberera amawulire, yogera mu lukiiko era owe endowooza yo.

u38.title: Ebigwa bitalaze
u38.description: Saba obuyambi, kola ku bubenje era oloope obubbi.

u39.title: Ekitiibwa n’empisa
u39.description: Lamusa abakadde n’ekitiibwa era obeere omugenyi omulungi.

u40.title: Engero z’edda
u40.description: Manya Wakayima ne Kintu, era ogambe eky’okuyiga mu lugero.

cast.ssali: Omuvuzi wa bodaboda amanyi buli kkubo
cast.emma: Omugenyi ayiga Oluganda nga tannaba kutambula
